title: 贮清书屋 Zhuqing Shuwu
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 5.8 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, left, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 藻园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 長春仙館由西南門迤西為藻園内為曠然堂五楹堂後為貯清書屋曠然堂東池上為夕佳書屋稍北為鏡瀾榭東南樓為凝眺為懷新館西北為湛碧軒西南為湛清華（圓明園冊）臣等謹按藻園曠然堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: Out by the south-west gate of 長春仙館: 藻園 with the five-bay 曠然堂, 貯清書屋, 夕佳書屋, 鏡瀾榭, the tower 凝眺, 懷新館, 湛碧軒 and 湛清華.

evidence.title: 贮清书屋: 乾隆十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆十八年 (1753), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.185 item (2), under 贮清书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh: 石上架山居，石势不可止。覆瓦于其上，贮石我屋里。受润无内外，皴缛苔纹起。张为生色屏，卧作醉道士。回头望山石，原不分彼此。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 贮清书屋, 1753, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 贮清书屋: 乾隆二十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十五年 (1760), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.185 item (1), under 贮清书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh: 㠎嶫复崚嶒，千回将万层。云闗纔得叩，石磴更须登。步处那辞倦，坐来实絶胜。龙标工比物，一片玉壶冰。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 贮清书屋, 1760, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 贮清书屋
evidence.locator: v3 p.221, under 藻园; source ref 9-176
evidence.excerpt_zh: 引流绕砌宛成池，小小书窗恰受宜。设曰一尘不到处，已居二谛落诠时。
evidence.summary: Poem 贮清书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1766, filed by the editors under 藻园.

evidence.title: 贮清书屋: 乾隆五十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十八年 (1793), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.186 item (5), under 贮清书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书屋由来称贮清，谓无些子俗尘萦。设如以小喻其大，方寸之中八表呈。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 贮清书屋, 1793, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 贮清书屋
evidence.summary: 贮清书屋: 5 dated items, 1753-1793, of which 5 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: reading. First dated 1753, last dated 1793.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 贮清书屋, 3x1 cells.
